basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 28-year-old vegan living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I'm usually gaming or exploring new vegan recipes. I've been into gaming since I was a kid, and I love keeping up with the latest releases, especially in the action-adventure and RPG genres. Besides gaming, I have a passion for sustainable living and am always on the lookout for ways to reduce my carbon footprint. I’m in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for animals and the environment. I usually browse Reddit during the late evenings after work, around 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of graphic design, having earned a degree in Visual Arts and worked in the field for over five years. My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and staying updated through gaming news outlets and YouTube channels. I'm also self-taught in vegan cooking, inspired by my commitment to a sustainable lifestyle.
